info.title: three.ws Market Data
info.description: Crypto and DeFi market data: coin tables, coin profiles, price history, sectors, exchanges, derivatives, TVL by protocol and chain, yield pools, stablecoin pegs, fees, DEX volume, exploit history, news pulse, and token signals.
info.x-guidance: Call an endpoint without payment to receive an x402 challenge, pay it in USDC on Solana mainnet, and retry with the payment header. Asynchronous 3D jobs return a token to poll for free at GET /api/forge?job=<token>.

get.summary: Fetch a one-call crypto market overview of eight feeds
get.description: Return global market cap and dominance, the fear and greed index, top 10 coins, trending searches, gas, DeFi TVL with top protocols, stablecoin supply, DEX volume, and protocol fees in one response.

400.description: Missing or invalid input. Refused before any payment settles.

402.description: Payment Required: an x402 challenge payable in USDC on Solana mainnet.

get.summary: Analyze a token by contract address with a market signal
get.description: Return price, 24h change, market cap, liquidity, 24h volume, and a bullish, bearish, or neutral signal with a two-sentence rationale for any token by contract address.

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: Token contract address: a Solana base58 mint or an EVM 0x address.

400.description: Missing or invalid input. Refused before any payment settles.

get.summary: Fetch a ranked crypto market table with 7-day sparklines
get.description: Return coins ranked by market cap with price, market cap, 24h volume, 24h and 7d change, logo, and a 7-day sparkline, up to 250 per page. Pass q to resolve a name or ticker to coin ids.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1-20. Default 1.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page, 10-250. Default 100.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional sector id from the market-categories endpoint to scope the table to one sector.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search mode: resolve a name or ticker to coin ids and return the top 10 matches.

get.summary: Search DeFi yield pools by chain, protocol, and TVL
get.description: Query about 15,000 DeFi yield pools filtered by chain, protocol, stablecoin exposure, or text, sorted by TVL or APY, with pagination. Pass pool for one pool's APY and TVL history.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Filter to one chain (case-insensitive, e.g. solana).

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Filter to one protocol slug, as listed by market-defi.

parameters.name: stablecoin
parameters.description: 'true' for stablecoin pools only, 'false' to exclude them.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Substring match over symbol, project, and chain.

parameters.name: minTvl
parameters.description: Minimum pool TVL in USD.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: 'tvl' (default) or 'apy' (dust-guarded to pools >= $10k TVL).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1-200. Default 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset. Default 0.

parameters.name: pool
parameters.description: Chart mode: a pool id from a previous market-yields row. Returns that pool's APY and TVL history.

400.description: Missing or invalid input. Refused before any payment settles.

402.description: Payment Required: an x402 challenge payable in USDC on Solana mainnet.
